'''Keycards''', also known as '''cardkeys''' or '''pass keys''', were small metallic cards that, when placed into a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] panel, allowed access to a room. Keycards were used to access security doors on the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Unit]] buildings on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]].<ref name="BS">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> They were also used at the [[Republic military base]] [[Prison/Legends|prison cells]] and for the cells of the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' prisoners on [[Ciutric IV]].<ref name="IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>
